scope: Fixed-source offline installation, side-by-side upgrade, integrity doctor and guarded uninstall only.

bases: Node 24 process, filesystem and SHA-256 APIs
reuse.reasonForLocalWrapper: Compose the existing doctor and reviewed build without retaining unrelated CLI tooling or prior inventory allocations during compilation.

changes: Transformation tooling is imported only for transformation CLI commands.
Inventory hashes every byte using one reusable 64 KiB buffer; all original path, mode, link, receipt and metadata checks remain.

Upgrade calls the identical doctor in a short-lived bounded Node process. Fixed reviewed code and separate argument arrays pass the module URL and previous directory; no shell, interpolated caller code or inherited Node loader options.
Previous inspection exits before full offline npm ci and the unchanged npm run build. Compiler old-space cap remains 640 MiB; qualifier, public CLI and doctor child are separately capped at 256 MiB.

checks.distribution: 8 of 8 cases passed on exact integrated commit
checks.focusedRegressionTests: 4 of 4 distribution cases passed using lightweight ES-module transpilation after the isolated-doctor change; exact integrated strict build then passed, and final aggregate test status is recorded separately.
checks.priorAggregate: 302 of 302 compiled tests and lint passed on tree 8fa176982b3ab49256542d64cad02ca672e89539 before the additional isolated-doctor regression.

retainedFailures.outcome: Legacy build OS-killed; failed, no installation readiness claim.
Legacy install/build/doctor passed; candidate build OS-killed. Both trees retained.
Explicit V8 heap exhaustion; lowering the compiler cap was rejected. No repeated heap-size cycle.

limitations: RSS observations are sampled, not a guaranteed worst-case bound. A V8 heap cap is not a process or aggregate RSS limit.
No cgroup or OOM-killer telemetry was available, so no hard OS memory threshold is asserted.
The fresh qualification installs were removed only by the harness after full integrity verification; retained prior partial/rollback evidence was not removed.
The receipt remains editable local integrity evidence, not authenticated publisher provenance.
No registry publication, service activation, host/database modification or production qualification.
nonQualifyingDiagnosticFailures: A legacy build profile using another checkout's workspace dependency symlinks produced duplicate-source TypeScript errors. That shared-layout diagnostic was rejected and was not installation evidence.

The first lightweight focused-test transpilation emitted CommonJS into an ESM package and failed at module load. Selecting ESNext module output corrected the diagnostic runner; all four tests then passed.
